tutorialcontent:
1. Purchase prices at Today's Greenmarket are influenced by the crop yields of all planets in the same market from the previous day.
2. Prices are the same within the same market.
3. Supply and demand apply: when a crop's yield was high yesterday, its market demand decreases, and today's price drops. Conversely, when yesterday's yield was low, today's price rises.
4. At <color=#be6106>12:00</color> and <color=#be6106>20:00</color> daily, purchase prices are updated based on the latest yields.
5. If you can predict which crops have low planting quantities in the current market, you are more likely to sell them at higher prices tomorrow.

2. The crop purchase list changes periodically.
3. Each time the purchase list refreshes, the market resets and all planets are reassigned to new markets.
4. Each planet's daily crop yield collectively affects demand in the Greenmarket, which in turn influences purchase prices.

tutorialcontent:
Mix ingredients to craft different fertilizers.

<color=#be6106>YieldBoost Fertilizer</color>: Increases the chance of higher yields, but has no effect on Plump or Dreamcrown crops.
<color=#be6106>QualityPro Fertilizer</color>: Increases the chance of growing higher-quality crops.
<color=#be6106>FastGro Fertilizer</color>: Reduces crop growth time, but has no effect on crops that mature in a single day.
tutorialgroupname: What types of fertilizer are available?

tutorialcontent:
Open your Backpack, select a fertilizer, and [LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#click] <color=#be6106>Use</color> to add it to your Watering Bucket.

You can also use Precision Farming mode to select a fertilizer before using the Watering Bucket.

The more materials you use, and the higher their quality, the more fertilizer you'll produce.

Different types of materials may yield different types of fertilizer:
Food materials are more likely to produce yield fertilizers, increasing the chance of growing multiple fruits.
Plant materials are more likely to produce vigor fertilizers, which improve the quality of the harvest.
Creature materials are more likely to produce maturity fertilizers, reducing growth time (does not apply to crops that mature in less than one day).

Choose your materials based on your crops' needs to mix the right fertilizer.
